$comment: Shared by tests/tsconfig.json and every features/<id>/tests/tsconfig.json. Tests are type-checked with the app's paths (@/, @features/, @shared/, @tests/), so no test needs a climbing relative import, but less strictly than the app: they use newer library APIs than the app target (Promise.withResolvers, Array.at) and loose fakes. A new feature copies its tests/tsconfig.json from an existing one.
